{{Top}}
A '''dataplaque''' was a handheld device used to store information. They required a reader to view their contents. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once recovered a data plaque owned by the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Zlarb/Legends|Zlarb]] that led him on a search to break the slaver ring and regain his lost ten thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] antiques dealer [[Saell-Terae]] used a data plaque to store [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] charts of parts of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. He hid the data plaque in the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] of his ship ''[[Lost Reef]]''. A data plaque was also central to the negotiations between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Aquaris Freeholders/Legends|Aquaris Freeholders]], where [[Kraaken]] tried to steal the data plaque for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] deliberately leaked the existence of the plaque to draw him out as a traitor. The data plaque was also modified by Leia with a micro-proton charge that was activated via remote detonation so that in the event that Kraaken escaped, she would blow him up before he could deliver the vital data to the Empire.
